pages.text: For necrosis or crushed limbs. Saw evenly without leaving the cut.

The stump heals, then a prosthesis fits: a foot, a peg leg, a hook. A foot prosthesis only on a living shin.$(br2)A severed limb can be reattached within $(cfg)6$() h.$(br2)A strong explosion can tear off a limb by itself.
